metricDefinitions.label: markets
metricDefinitions.definition: One current market per ticker. Catalog prices in dollars per $1 contract; spreads in cents; volume/open interest in contracts. Books sampled for the top 40 by 24h volume across selected series; not sampled is not zero.

caveats: Bounded selected-series coverage, not the full exchange.
Quotes are market prices, not independently estimated probabilities.
The saved source timestamp applies to seeded observations; each runtime row records actual retrieval time.

metricDefinitions.label: evaluation
metricDefinitions.definition: One settled binary KXHIGHNY market. Midpoint of the last valid hourly bid/ask closing quote at or before close_time minus 24h; maximum lag 2h. Brier=(p-y)^2. No post-cutoff quote enters the forecast.

caveats: Bounded selected-series snapshot, not the full exchange.
Historical evaluation is NYC weather only, 20 recent events; not evidence of profitable trading.
Quotes are market prices, not independently estimated true probabilities.

evidenceFlow.title: Fee scenario
evidenceFlow.detail: Cent-rounded coefficient × multiplier × contracts × P × (1 − P), with editable coefficient and multiplier; this is an illustrative scenario, not a series-specific fee quote.

evidenceFlow.title: Sportsbook and revenue scenario
evidenceFlow.detail: User-entered American odds converted to implied probabilities; overround is their sum minus one. Modeled GGR is assumed handle times assumed hold. No external OSB quote or operator revenue feed is connected.

caveats: Scenario outputs are not observed operator revenue, realized hold, migration or RevPAR forecasts.
